terminal_gate: No product may be ratified until every context it imports is adjudicated and its required semantic owners are unique.

phases.name: Metamodel and enumeration
phases.gate: Axes, record schema, ambiguity accounting and deterministic review queue validate.

phases.name: Foundational meaning and intent
phases.gate: Identity, type, time, observation, evidence, authority and analytical-intent owners are adjudicated.

phases.name: Source to governed data product
phases.gate: A hostile source occurrence can become an exact governed cut without semantic or authority gaps.

phases.name: Modality, transformation and dynamic computation
phases.gate: Batch, stream, incremental, correction and rebuild semantics are explicitly related and testable.

phases.name: Persistence, query and semantic consumption
phases.gate: Exact cuts can be stored, queried and interpreted through portable semantic definitions without provider ownership leakage.

phases.name: Trust, authority, security and evidence
phases.gate: Quality, derivation, access, disclosure, revocation and independent appraisal have separate owners and fail-closed laws.

phases.name: Analytical studies, results and decisions
phases.gate: Questions close into reproducible observations/proposals and re-enter business contexts only through explicit authority.

phases.name: Client, runtime, evolution and assurance
phases.gate: Compiled solutions can be operated, changed, exited and independently appraised under finite budgets.

phases.name: Global context-map adjudication
phases.gate: No duplicate semantic owner, unknown dependency, ownership cycle or unaccounted homonym remains in the bounded corpus.

phases.name: Capabilities, machines and product derivation
phases.gate: Every product boundary traces to adjudicated contexts, capabilities, implementations, provider requirements and the 110-truth applicability profile.
